explanation: The Seshachalam hills (Tirumala, Tirupati) are an Eastern Ghats range of southern AP, so the added option 'Eastern Ghats' is the answer (official APPSC key: Nilgiri Hills). The Nilgiri, Cardamom, Annamalai and Palani hills are Western Ghats hills.
